entries.0d23f8ea17c2f7c0: Its company motto is 'With love, sincerity (magokoro) and gratitude, we will become a Fujiya that customers love', and its mission is to create the 'bonds' between people and the 'color' in daily life that confectionery brings, and to realize a 'world where hearts are warmed'. As its medium- to long-term vision (grand design), it has set 'Sweets to next stage! From peace of mind to wakuwaku', and its policy is to create group synergies by leveraging its strength of having both Western Confectionery and Confectionery businesses, and to strengthen collaboration with its parent company, YAMAZAKI BAKING CO., LTD. Toward realizing sustainability management, it established an ESG Committee in 2024.
